title: messaging.message_deleted
description: MessageDeleted is published when a message is deleted, in a server channel or in a direct conversation (ServerID is empty then and ChannelID is the conversation). OccurredAt is the moment of the deletion. A consumer drops whatever it kept about MessageID.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

server_id.description: Servidor del canal. No viaja si el mensaje era directo.

channel_id.description: Canal del mensaje, o la conversación si era un mensaje directo.
